text_block_list.name: Windy and Teio
text_block_list.text: MWAAAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You gotta do it with more oomph!<n>Make it way more
sinister! Again!

text_block_list.name: Windy and Teio
text_block_list.text: MWAAAHAHAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What in the world are those two<n>doing? I call them
both into my office<n>to see what's up.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Teio has become my disciple of<n>darkness!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
She wanted me to teach her some<n>pranks! I
couldn't just turn her down,<n>so I made her my
disciple!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yo! Master Windy, teach me a prank<n>to scare the
pants off of Prez!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Talk of disciples aside, I do recall that<n>Tokai Teio is
rather attached to<n>Symboli Rudolf, but...
choice_data_list: Are you sure you should be pranking her?
Are you sure you should be pranking her?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
D-don't sweat it! It's her fault for<n>never spending
time with me<n>anyway! All she ever talks about is
"duties" this and "inspections" that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems they must have had a bit of<n>a falling-out...
For the moment, I<n>decide to accompany the two
students to make sure they don't do<n>anything
reckless.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! At the core of any decent<n>prank is fear!
You gotta really aim to<n>startle 'em!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But for someone like the president, a<n>vicious growl
ain't gonna cut it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: We need a super scary prank that'llleave her shakin' in her boots!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The trick to pulling off this prank is an
ultra-classified secret, but seein' as<n>you're my
disciple, I'll let you in on it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The secret is... Psst, psssst...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Put a whoopee cushion on her chair inthe student council office and scribblegraffiti on the wall?! You really are anexpert, Master Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, not so loud—you never know<n>who might be
listenin'! But it's pretty<n>wicked, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A whoopee cushion is... innocent<n>enough, but I think
graffiti would invite<n>more than a surprised reaction
from<n>the president—they'd be in for a<n>proper
telling-off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't put it past these two to<n>actually go
through with it, either. I try<n>to stop them by quickly
changing the<n>subject.
choice_data_list: Instead of a prank, why don't you make up?
How about creating a giant jack-in-the-box?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Make up? Didja get in a fight or<n>something,
Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A-a fight? We weren't fighting! It's<n>just that Prez
is, well...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She ignores me whenever I visit her<n>in the office,
and she turns down my<n>invitations to train together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She never has lunch with me, and our<n>plan to run
together this morning fell<n>through! She won't spend
any time<n>with me at all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No way! She's givin' ya the cold<n>shoulder?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... How could she treat my<n>precious disciple like
that?! I won't<n>forgive her!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Are you really getting that mad for my<n>sake?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm your master! And now<n>I've got a
bone or two to pick with<n>her! Be right back!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: H-huh? You're kidding, right? Hang<n>on a sec!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, Miss President! GRAWR!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy and Teio? What on<n>earth is going on?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: W-w-wait! Please stop, Master<n>Windy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although her methods were<n>unconventional, Shinko
Windy seems<n>to have helped the two of them make
up... At least, I think she has?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's my trainer for ya! Great idea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we quickly set about<n>constructing a giant
jack-in-the-box.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now, the quality of the spring is super<n>important!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm... "Quality of the spring...<n>super
important!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! It's gotta really whoosh<n>out! So that the
face appears like,<n>bam! And once it's out, it needs
to be<n>all wibbly-wobbly!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Whoosh... bam... wibble-wobble!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And that's that! Now I'm gonnashow you how it's done, so watchreeeal close!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The spring is super strong, so you<n>wanna make
sure you put the lid on<n>tight! Give it a go, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yes, Master Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Niiice. Hold it down... Heh, you got<n>talent for this
kinda thing!

text_block_list.name: Windy and Teio
text_block_list.text: Ya did it! Finished!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! With something this big,<n>even Prez is sure
to jump out of her<n>skin! Thanks, Master Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heehee! What can I say? I'm a<n>genius!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you ever need help again, come<n>straight to me.
Someone's gotta help<n>ya out!
